#123 · Mantis Pokémon

Scyther

Bug Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Scyther is a Bug/Flying-type Mantis Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 56 kg. It evolves into Scizor and Kleavor. Its highest base stat is Attack (110), with a base stat total of 500.
